# Features:
## Hud Elements:
- Pickup Log (shows what items you picked up / dropped)
- Timer/Stopwatch hud (show timer and stopwatch as a hud element, insted of action bar)
- Horse Stats (Show stats of a horse when riding it)
- Waila (Displays real-time block and entity info directly on your screen)

## Modules:
- Shuffle (Shuffles hotbar blocks on place so you have random patern)
- Timer (Set time and when time runs out sound is played)
- Stopwatch (its a stopwatch are you dumb)
- AutoFish (Automaticly cast fishing rod) (Server Unsafe) 
- BookEdit (Scribble, https://modrinth.com/mod/scribble)
- Light Level (Shows light level info on block)
- Fast Place (Removes the block place delay, can trigger anticheats) (Server Unsafe)
- Fast Break (Removes the break delay can be used in creative mode only)
- No hurtcam
- Auto Tool (switches your selected slot to a tool on mine of a block)
- AutoClicker (Automaticly perform clicks)
- Shield Status (Show when the shield is broken with a customized overlay)
- Tablist: Ping (shows players ping next to name)
- Totem Counter (shows your totems in hud and show enemy pop times in the tablist)

## Commands:
- Calc/Calculator Cactus Commands (math)
- PrivateShare/Share commands (share your cords)

Incompatable if it detects it auto disabled the modules and mixins:
- https://modrinth.com/mod/ping-view, https://modrinth.com/mod/better-ping-display-fabric
- https://modrinth.com/mod/scribble
- https://modrinth.com/mod/accurate-block-placement-reborn
- https://modrinth.com/mod/no-break-cooldown
- https://modrinth.com/mod/shuffle

# Requirments:
- Cactus mod
- Fabric api

Report if find incompatable mods
